actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_user.description: Delete a user from Knock by their ID.
actions.delete_user.props.userId.descrip: The unique identifier of the user to delete.
actions.get_message.description: Retrieve a Knock message by its ID.
actions.get_message.props.messageId.desc: The unique identifier of the message.
actions.get_user.description: Retrieve a user from Knock by their ID.
actions.get_user.props.userId.descriptio: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve.
actions.identify_user.description: Create or update a user in Knock.

actions.list_messages.description: List Knock messages with optional filters and pagination.
actions.list_messages.props.page_size.de: Number of messages per page (1–50, default 50).

actions.trigger_workflow.description: Trigger a Knock notification workflow for one or more recipients.
actions.trigger_workflow.props.actorId.d: The user ID of the person performing the action (optional).
actions.trigger_workflow.props.data.desc: Key-value data passed to the workflow template (optional).

actions.trigger_workflow.props.tenant.de: Optional tenant identifier for multi-tenant workflows.
